LanguageData.ESCP_ImperialLegion_Enlist_Letter_Label: A legate has entered the colony's name in the rolls. Your people now serve the Ruby Throne, and the Legion quartermasters will pay and supply them at any Imperial settlement.
LanguageData.ESCP_ImperialLegion_Enlist_Button_Desc: Take the Emperor's coin and the Legion's oath. Pay is regular, the discipline is not optional, and the paperwork never ends.
LanguageData.ESCP_ImperialLegion_Enlist_Requrements_N: The Legion does not enlist strangers. Imperial standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_ImperialLegion_Enlisted_To_Hostile_: The Legion will not take an oath from an enemy of the Empire.
LanguageData.ESCP_ImperialLegion_Missions_Desc: See what the quartermaster needs done.
LanguageData.ESCP_ImperialLegion_Menu_Missions_Desc: Orders posted at the Legion fort. The paymaster settles up once a job is finished.
LanguageData.ESCP_ImperialLegion_Provisions_Desc: Hardtack, salted meat and field dressings from the Legion stores.
LanguageData.ESCP_ImperialLegion_Storage_Desc: Leave goods with the fort clerk and claim them at any Imperial post.
LanguageData.ESCP_ImperialLegion_Resign_Menu_Text: Ask to be discharged from the Legion? The Empire does not think well of deserters.
LanguageData.ESCP_ImperialLegion_Resign_Letter_Label: The colony's name has been struck from the Legion rolls. Imperial officers will remember it.
LanguageData.ESCP_ImperialLegion_Resign_Button_Desc: Hand back the oath and the pay that comes with it.
LanguageData.ESCP_ImperialLegion_Kick_Out_Label_Title: The colony has fallen out of favor with the Empire, and the Legion no longer counts it among its own.
LanguageData.ESCP_ImperialLegion_Salary_Desc: The paymaster pays in septims, on time, and wants a signature for every one.
LanguageData.ESCP_ImperialLegion_Work_0_Desc: March the Gold Road with a Legion patrol. Dull, tiring and well paid.
LanguageData.ESCP_ImperialLegion_Work_1_Desc: A decanus with a loud voice teaches shield work and the short sword.
